name: Readers Allowance to Visually Impaired Persons
benefit: > **Reader's allowance is being paid at the following rate:** - 9th**** To 10th Standard - ₹3,000/- (per annum).- Degree Courses - ₹5,000/- (per annum). - Post Graduate and Professional Courses - ₹6,000/- (per annum).
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a visually impaired student.
1. The applicant enrolled in 9th standard or above in a recognized/bonafide institution.
